scope: Production liquidGlass HWUI/Window PixelCopy; bevel20 then bevel6 on one retained consumer per pair. No native optical or motion parity claim.
geometry_scope: Controlled circular capsule333x62dp/radius31dp and rounded rectangle300x240dp/radius28dp; production material factories only. The sheet fixture is not the actual App sheet contour or layout.
source: Existing OpticalCaptureBackground drawn and recorded in an external LayerBackdrop; source-only references stay in memory and are not PNG artifacts

backgrounds.input: Procedural 720x1280 landscape v1, seed 0x51EE9: textured clouds, ridgelines, lake reflections and near shore; synthetic, not a photograph

sampling_policy: Analytic circular rounded-rectangle inset from measured bounds. Center is beyond max effective bevel + 8dp; edge is 2dp inside AA to 2dp before the old bevel boundary; outside probes are at least3dp outside. No cross-source comparison.
thresholds: Center/outside max channel delta<=1; opaque captured alpha>=254; each material phase mean center/source RGB delta>=0.5; each shape/theme has >=4dp^2 edge pixels changing by >=2 levels across four backgrounds.
threshold_reason: One 8-bit level permits quantization only. Edge area rejects isolated AA noise and fails an ignored bevel. Blurred fine grids can be flat, so edge sensitivity is required per shape/theme across all backgrounds, not falsely demanded of every uniform patch.
limits: Frame commits and PixelCopy read the Window surface. Runtime support, compiled production shader, effect attachment, source recording, unchanged center and a bevel-sensitive GPU edge guard fallback/transparent failures behaviorally; they are not exhaustive introspection of every GPU driver path.
